_method: 16 random-origin ~9.9 A cubic boxes per system; box channel %% = voxels of the TRUE periodic map crop with (BVSE - orig global min) <= iso. Answers 'does the cubic frame reorder the systems?' -> NO: box means recover the original-cell values; single-box differences (e.g. lpsocl 3.40 < modelc 4.37 in the registered display boxes) are within ~1sigma sampling noise. Canonical ordering (original cells): modelc 3.32 < lpsocl 4.74 < b2o3 6.73 at iso 0.5.

b2o3.note: huge sigma = REAL dopant locality (boxes hitting the B2O3 region reach ~24%); mean still recovers the cell average
